nodes.label: templates/ Custom LaTeX Template Folder
nodes.rationale: Only gets content when the user registers their own template; templates are stored with [PLACEHOLDER] tokens instead of personal data so they are safe to commit and share.

nodes.label: TEMPLATE.md Manifest (engine, fonts, page limit, pitfalls)
nodes.rationale: Activating a template writes a managed block into 05-cv-templates.md or 06-cover-letter-templates.md, which is what /apply already reads - so no other wiring is needed.
